title: Patagonia Sues Trump Over Reduction of Bears Ears National Monument in Utah
description: The outdoor apparel maker joined environmental and Native American groups in challenging President Trump’s reduction of Bears Ears National Monument.
author: Maxine Joselow

title: In Small Iranian Town, a U.S. Attack Turns a Wedding Into a Tragedy
description: The bomb that hit the residential area was American, according to a weapons expert and a visual analysis by The Times. It killed five people and wounded 67 others, the Iranian authorities said.
author: Christiaan Triebert, Malachy Browne, Farnaz Fassihi and Erika Solomon

title: Is Steve Hilton the Future of Trumpism?
description: Steve Hilton wants to “Make California Golden Again.”
author: Samuel Earle

title: I Went to Princeton to Become a So-So Indian
description: I realized that in this country Indians were not supposed to be happy or to pursue happiness. We were supposed to suffer and to pursue suffering.
author: David Treuer

title: USPS Is Building a Mail-In Ballot Screening System Despite Legal Battles Over Trump Order
description: Election officials warn that the creation of a new online portal for states to upload voter information is already fueling confusion and could ultimately disenfranchise voters.
author: Eileen Sullivan

title: Trump Administration Launches Hunt For Noncitizen Voter Fraud Before Midterms
description: Election fraud is exceedingly rare, but President Trump has fixated on rooting it out this year, claiming without evidence that tens of thousands of noncitizens are registered to vote.
author: Nick Corasaniti and Hamed Aleaziz

title: Wendell Berry, Writer Who Extolled America’s Agrarian Past, Dies at 92
description: A Kentucky farmer, he railed against agribusiness and championed small family farms and the environment, winning widespread acclaim.
author: Robert D. McFadden

title: Kennedy Center Removes ‘Blue’ Sculpture That Was an Artist’s Gift
description: The towering artwork, added to the campus in 2019, was targeted for elimination after President Trump’s takeover of the center.
author: Elizabeth Williamson and Julia Jacobs

title: Wondering How Nuts Trump’s Tariffs Are? Consider Aluminum.
description: Canada is better at making aluminum than we are. Let’s just import it and make something else.
author: Bill Saporito

title: Employer Health Costs Are Expected to Spike in 2027
description: A new U.S. survey anticipates an average increase of 11 percent unless benefits are cut, the highest rate in decades. Other findings also predict a sharp rise.
author: Reed Abelson

title: Trump’s Speed on the White House Ballroom Threatens to Outpace the Courts
description: In his breakneck construction of a grand ballroom and in many other initiatives, critics say, the president has tried to outrun judicial review.
author: Adam Liptak

title: My Home Is Besieged By Israeli Settlers. This Flag Is My Only Protection.
description: As Israeli settlers encroach on his home, one Palestinian American man has hoisted the American flag.
author: Loui Ridi

title: Saturday Evening Post Will Stop Printing After 205 Years
description: The magazine, famous for publishing Jack London stories and Norman Rockwell art, will continue online.
author: Benjamin Mullin

title: Whistle-Blower Says USPS Is Secretly Proceeding on Trump’s Mail Voting Plan Before Midterms
description: The Postal Service disputed allegations by the whistle-blower that the agency had violated several court orders that should have halted work on the plan.
author: Chris Cameron

title: Haitian Student, Despondent Over Ankle Monitor, Dies in Apparent Suicide
description: The 20-year-old was fitted with a tracking device under a Trump administrative initiative targeting Haitians in Springfield, Ohio.
author: Miriam Jordan

title: The U.S. Military Must Learn to Say No to Trump
description: How senior leaders of the armed forces dodge accountability.
author: Frank Kendall

title: A New World Order Is Coming. We Aren’t Ready.
description: We must be honest about the seriousness of the situation we’re in.
author: Margaret MacMillan

title: At 70, Yo-Yo Ma Is Modeling a Way to Be in the World Today
description: With a global audience, Ma models a way of being that goes against the grain of cynicism, polarization and isolation. It’s up to us to pay attention.
author: Joshua Barone and Benjamin Rasmussen For The New York Times

title: Book Review: ‘53 Days,’ by Timothy W. Ryback
description: In “53 Days,” the historian Timothy W. Ryback shows how the Nazis used democratic means to destroy German democracy.
author: Sam Adler-Bell

title: Deportees Sent to Liberia Recount Harrowing Details of U.S. Expulsion and Treatment by ICE
description: Ten deportees said they experienced or witnessed what they called abusive or violent treatment by ICE. They spent months in detention, they said, before being sent to nations where they had no ties.
author: Emmanuel Akinwotu, Pranav Baskar, Genevieve Glatsky and Hamed Aleaziz
